summary: This Form 8-K reports an underwritten public offering by PDF Solutions, Inc. under an effective shelf registration statement. The company sold 1,946,630 shares and a selling stockholder sold 3,306,924 shares at $44.00 per share, raising ~$85.7 million gross for the issuer. The offering closed on May 15, 2026. No premium, strategic review, acquisition, or structural event is involved; it is a routine capital markets transaction. A shelf takedown with a selling stockholder does not constitute a special situation. There is no deal to watch or risk-arb angle.
